ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBa.en: Did I just win?\nOr did I lose?
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBa.fr: J'ai gagné ou… ? Je viens de perdre\nlà !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro.en: My mommy said that I can't swim\nwithout my float ring.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro.fr: Maman a dit que je pouvais pas\nnager sans ma bouée.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBat.en: This year, I'm going to finally\nlearn how to swim!
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBat.fr: Juré craché, cette année\nj'apprendrai à nager !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSi.en: BOND BRIDGE\nPlease be quiet when crossing.\pBERRY FOREST AHEAD
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSi.fr: PONT DU LIEN Silence en traversant.\pBOIS BAIES DROIT DEVANT

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_DenLocked.en: Mist rolls out of the cave mouth.\nThe tide is not ready for you.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_DenLocked.fr: La brume sort de l'entrée de la\ngrotte. La marée n'est pas prête\lpour toi.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro.en: JOY: We'll teach you what our\nfavorite POKéMON is!
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro.fr: JOY : On va te montrer quel est\nnotre POKéMON préféré !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnough.en: JOY: I really want to battle with\nMEG.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnough.fr: JOY : J'ai vraiment envie de me\nbattre avec MEG.\pUn POKéMON ne suffit pas.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattl.en: JOY: Wasn't that fun?\nI hope we can battle again!
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattl.fr: JOY : C'était amusant, non ?\nJ'espère qu'on pourra se battre\lencore !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro.en: MEG: We'll show you our favorite\nPOKéMON.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro.fr: MEG : On va te montrer notre\nPOKéMON préféré.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnough.en: MEG: I want to battle together\nwith JOY.\pOne POKéMON isn't enough.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnough.fr: MEG : Je veux me battre ensemble\navec JOY.\pUn POKéMON ne suffit pas.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro.en: The salty tang of the sea…\nIt tickles my heart.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro.fr: Le goût salé de la mer…\nIl me chatouille le cœur.

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBat.en: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty\nPOKéMON's body odor…
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBat.fr: Tu laves jamais tes POKéMON ? Ça\nsent vraiment pas bon…

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat.en: Okay, you've won!\nNow will you please go away?
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat.fr: D'accord, t'as gagné !\nMaintenant, tu veux bien partir ?

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro.en: Oh, no, don't come here!\nPlease, stay away from me!
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro.fr: Oh non, ne viens pas ici !\nReste loin de moi, s'il te plaît !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBat.en: A POKéMON bit through my \nswimsuit.\pI can't get out of the water!
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBat.fr: Un POKéMON a mordu mon maillot de\nbain.\pJe peux pas sortir de l'eau !

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro.en: Where are you off to in such\na hurry?

ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBa.en: If you keep going this way, you'll\neventually reach BERRY FOREST.
ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBa.fr: Si tu continues ton chemin, tu vas\ntomber sur les BOIS BAIES.
